sections.text_helper: Section 23.4.5 "Window comparator (optional feature)" in chapter 23 (Comparator (COMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 715.
sections.section_content:
The purpose of the window comparator is to monitor the analog voltage to ensure it is within
the voltage range defined by the lower and upper thresholds.
The two embedded comparators, COMP1 and COMP2, can be used to create a window
comparator. The monitored analog voltage is connected to the noninverting (plus) inputs of
comparators connected together (COMP1 or COMP2). The upper and lower threshold
voltages are connected to the inverting (minus) inputs of the comparators.
The output of the window comparator (COMP1 or COMP2) is selected with the control bit
WINOUT.
